website_summary.name: Poetic Muse Gallery
website_summary.description: The website features a clean and elegant design with a light goldenrod background and olive drab accents, providing a serene environment for poetry enthusiasts.
website_summary.appearance: The website has a minimalist and aesthetically pleasing design. The header is olive drab with white text, featuring the title "Poetry Blog" and navigation buttons for "Home," "Add Poem," and "Filter." Below the header, there's a search bar for browsing poems. The main content area displays a grid of poetry cards, each with a title, author, date, a snippet of the poem, and the number of comments. The cards have a light goldenrod background with rounded edges and a subtle shadow, enhancing their visual appeal. The overall layout is well-organized, ensuring readability and user-friendliness.
website_summary.functionality:
The website includes several key functionalities: 
- A search bar allows users to find specific poems by entering keywords.
- Users can add their own poems via the "Add Poem" button.
- The "Filter" option enables users to browse different types of poetry.
- Each poem card includes a snippet of the poem and the number of comments, suggesting a commenting feature for user interaction.
